title: The coaches want a heavy week
text: A heavy week on the track, or a week to freshen up?

choices.label: Heavy week
choices.result: A heavy week on the track. The legs will know about it on game day.

choices.label: Recovery week
choices.note: The players miss a full session's work.
choices.result: A recovery week: fresher bodies and minds.

title: {name} is pushing for games
text: The kid's flying at training and wants a senior game.

choices.label: Back {first} for {run_games} games
choices.note: Nothing develops a player like AFL footy.

choices.label: Develop {first} instead
choices.note: {name} wanted a game. A week with the development coaches tells him he isn't ready. He can't be picked this week.

effects.why: You told him he isn't ready for a senior game

choices.result: {name} spends the week with the development coaches.

title: {name} is staying back to kick goals
text: He's been staying back with the forwards coach after most sessions. The fitness staff would rather he went home.

choices.label: Let {first} stay back

effects.why: You let him put in the extra work

choices.result: {name} stays back with the forwards coach again.

choices.label: Send {first} home
choices.result: {name} is sent home with the rest of them.

title: {name} and {player_b} got into it at match sim
text: The two of them had to be pulled apart. The assistants reckon it's the edge you've been after.

choices.label: Let it go

effects.why: A fight at match sim was left alone

choices.result: It stays on the track. {first} and {first_b} won't be swapping numbers.

choices.label: Pull the group up

effects.why: You pulled the group up after a fight at match sim

choices.result: You pull the group up. The standard is set.

title: The leaders have asked for Monday off
text: The leaders have asked for Monday off after a long block. The fitness staff are split.

choices.label: Give them the day
choices.result: Monday off. Fresh legs on game day.

choices.label: We train Monday
choices.result: Monday's on. A few long faces.

stakes: A day off costs us Monday's session.

title: The fitness staff want a time trial
text: A two-kilometre time trial in the middle of the season. It shows us who's fit. Nobody loves it.

choices.label: Run it
choices.result: The time trial's done. Best over the two k: {best3}. Off the pace: {worst2}.

choices.label: Skip it
choices.result: No time trial. The group's relieved.

title: The midfield coach has a new stoppage set-up
text: He's been working on it for weeks. He wants all of Thursday to drill it.

choices.label: Give him Thursday
choices.result: Thursday is all stoppages.

choices.label: Keep our set-up
choices.result: The set-up stays in the drawer for now. The players keep their usual light Thursday.

title: {name} has taken his chance
text: You gave him his run and he's grabbed it. The other kids have noticed.

choices.label: Say he's earned it

effects.why: You told him he'd earned his spot

choices.result: {name} hears it from you.

choices.label: Keep him grounded
choices.result: You keep {name} working.

title: {name} is finding senior footy hard
text: You backed him for a run of games. It's been tough going.

effects.why: You kept backing him when it was hard

choices.label: Send {first} down

effects.why: You sent him back to the twos

choices.result: {name} heads back to the twos.

title.text: Straight through to a preliminary final

title: A week off while the wildcards play

text.text: Qualifying final won and a week off. A home preliminary final to come.

text: A top-six finish buys a week off. The old argument is back: rest or rust?

choices.label: Rest them
choices.result: Two light sessions and a few days away from the club.

choices.label: A full-contact match sim
choices.result: Match practice on Thursday, full contact. Not everyone's thrilled.

choices.label: Watch the semi together
choices.result: Everyone watches the semi together in the theatrette. They know who's coming.

title: {name} wants a word about the {proj_word} move
text: Week {proj_week} of {proj_weeks} learning to play as a {proj_word}. {first} rates {proj_there} there and {proj_own} in his own spot. He has to get within {proj_pass} points by week {proj_weeks}. Players this far off at this stage get there {take_odds} times. He wants to know what it's for.

choices.label: Promise a run there

effects.why: You promised him games in his new position if the move works

choices.result: You tell {name} he gets three games {proj_line} if the move works.

choices.label: Say it's for depth

effects.why: You were straight with him that his new position is for depth

choices.result: You tell {name} it gives us cover {proj_line}. He's picked there when we need him.
